name: codex
title: Codex launcher
author: Bennett Garcia
summary: Launch Codex app-server agents through the Rust A2 bridge.
description: Adds New Codex agent, shared runtime settings and explicit shared-login switching consent. At a subscription limit, switches automatically by restarting the agent on the other account; the conversation continues. All managed hosts sharing the setup are fenced and each native saved login and exact thread resume is confirmed. Common accounts policy owns one new labelled continuation turn, never earlier input replay. Codex owns credentials and refresh; vqro reads no profile/token files. Disabling this extension leaves existing processes intact.

needs.why: Codex runs in a backend-owned terminal through vqro-bridge-codex

works_with.without: Automatic cutover is unavailable; no native login switch occurs
New named-account choices default to ask
The created agent remains available through human Control; request route configuration is reported unconfirmed, never replayed
Request route initialization is unconfirmed; native spawn is never retried
A created agent opens as its bridge terminal
The observed host remains reachable through the resource picker
